messages:
maria: morning all — noticed a cluster-level uptick in preempt evictions + a lot of tiny pods Pending in us-west2 around 06:10 UTC. Looks concentrated to a single rack (rack-17). Node logs show repeated conntrack warnings and the warmpool handoff metric stalled.

alex: Any config changes last night? taints/labels/packer rollout?

maria: infra rolled node-labels v2 (zone=weighted) and tightened the autoscaler probe timeout to 6s. rollout was gradual but rack-17 got mostly v2.

jun: Scheduler traces show backfill churn and failed attach attempts: ```E0904 06:11:02 backfill failed: conntrack quota exceeded
E0904 06:11:03 attach timeout: egress qlen high```

sam: Pod sizes: tiny(<=0.25)=92, small(0.5)=19, medium(1)=8 pending across rack-17; co-location dropped so mediums can't pack -> capacity waste. Estimated +35% vGPU-hours.

maria: Quick canary: relaxed tiny pod anti-affinity in us-west2c -> pending down ~55% in that AZ. Patch we applied: ```kubectl patch deploy tiny-runner -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":null}}}}'```

alex: Ok rollback the label rollout for rack-17 and throttle the rest. Also bump conntrack sysctl on nodes short-term.

ops: Doing conntrack bump now (net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max -> 524288) and pausing rollout in us-west2a. Alerts created: evictions.pods.rate > 8/min.

jun: I'll draft a scheduler change to bias binpacking for tiny pods (prefer homogeneous packing) and add NIC egress pressure into scoring. Opening PR and perf tests.

sre-bot: INC-2026-6482 created, paging oncall.

maria: Adding telemetry request: per-node small_pod_count and a packing-entropy gauge + dashboard heatmap. That should catch these rack-level skews earlier.

ops: Rollback applied at 06:22 UTC. Warmpool handoff recovered ~25% and pending dropped to 36. Keeping watch for 90m.

maria: Thanks — will follow up with a postmortem draft and cost impact calc. :thumbsup:
